title: Isolation of Membrane-enriched Fractions from Mouse Cortical Neurons
author: Odetta Antico
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxjupknw

steps.title: Depolarize or Uncouple Mitochondrial Membrane
steps.instruction: Treat neuronal cultures with a combination of 10 µM Antimycin A and 1 µM Oligomycin dissolved in DMSO at 37 °C for 9 hours.

steps.title: Collect Neuronal Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells from the wells using PBS containing inhibitors.

substeps.instruction: Gently aspirate media from wells.
Add 1 mL of PBS+inhibitors to each well at room temperature (do not use cold PBS to prevent cell detachment).
Scrape neuronal cells and collect them in a labelled 50 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate the cell pellet and resuspend in HB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 500 x g for 3 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend pellets in 2 mL of HB buffer with freshly added inhibitors.

steps.title: Homogenize Cells
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the cells using a stainless steel Dounce homogeniser tissue grinder.

substeps.instruction: Perform 40 strokes, slowly pressing and twisting the pestle.
Avoid completely removing the pestle to prevent bubble generation and preserve organelles.
Verify cell lysis using Trypan blue (4 µL lysate + 4 µL trypan blue); 90% of cells should be disrupted.

steps.title: Isolate Post-Nuclear Supernatant (PNS)
steps.instruction: Separate nuclei and intact cells from the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Collect the resulting supernatant as the post-nuclear supernatant (PNS).

steps.title: Isolate Total Membrane Fractions
steps.instruction: Perform ultracentrifugation to separate the cytosolic fraction from the membrane fractions.

substeps.instruction: Transfer PNS to an ultracentrifuge tube, filling it at least 4/5 with HB buffer to prevent collapse and equalizing weight to <0.01g.
Spin at 200,000 x g (40,000 rpm) for 1 hour at 4 °C.
Remove the supernatant (cytosolic fraction).
Collect the pellet (membrane fractions).

steps.title: Prepare Membrane Pellets for Analysis
steps.instruction: Process the membrane pellet for Western Blotting or proteomic experiments.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the pellet to an Eppendorf tube using a pipette tip.
Add 200 µL - 300 µL of MitoBuffer.
Sonicate the pellet with a probe sonicator at 20% amplitude for 5 seconds or until completely resuspended.

steps.title: Quantify Protein and Store
steps.instruction: Determine protein concentration and store lysates.

substeps.instruction: Quantify protein using the Coomassie Protein Assay.
Prepare samples according to the specific experiment.
Store membrane lysates at -80 °C.
